title: How to change the colour theme

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: How to change the colour theme

slide_intent: Check consequences of palette changes so a new theme does not silently reduce chart legibility.
strategic_value: Restoring outlines and checking labels can keep Helsinki charts readable after recoloring.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: a long sequence of Excel screenshots and notes covers theme changes, chart colors, missing outlines and label contrast.
practical_value: After changing a theme, update chart colors, restore black outlines and check label contrast; line charts need additional judgment.

content_islands.name: Theme and chart changes
content_islands.spec: Upper screenshots show document and chart color controls.

content_islands.name: Repair and contrast
content_islands.spec: Lower screenshots and notes address outlines, line charts and label colors.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says to restore black outlines manually after recoloring and warns that not all colors are accessible in line charts.

ingredient.name: Chart color theme
ingredient.role: Distinguish data while preserving readable boundaries and labels.
ingredient.application: After changing theme colors, update chart colors, restore black outlines and check label contrast; line charts need additional accessibility judgment.
ingredient.scope: The demonstrated Helsinki M365 chart-template workflow, not a universal rule for all charts or brand graphics.
